# Schema Designer

A Tauri desktop app (Rust backend in `src-tauri/`, React view in `src/`) for designing systems and PostgreSQL schemas.
It was rewritten from an Electrobun app; nothing of Electrobun remains in the code.

- Run: `bun install`, then `bun run tauri dev` (or `cargo tauri dev`). Build: `bun run tauri build`.
- Rust tests: `cd src-tauri && cargo test --workspace`. View tests: `bun run test`. Types: `bun run typecheck`.
- The view and the backend talk through the typed contract in `src/shared/rpc.ts` over Tauri commands
  (`src/backend/tauri-rpc.ts`, `src-tauri/src/rpc.rs`).
- Behaviour of the backend is pinned by recordings in `src-tauri/fixtures/` (see its README).
- Start with README.md and docs/development.md.
